question: A Van de Graaff generator with a dome of radius $R$ is used to accelerate protons. When operated in open air up to the breakdown field strength $E_{max}$, it can accelerate a proton to a maximum kinetic energy $K_{iso}$. The generator is then enclosed within a large, concentric, earthed conducting shell of radius $4R$. If the generator is again operated up to the same maximum electric field strength $E_{max}$ at the surface of its dome, what is the new maximum kinetic energy $K_{cap}$ to which a proton can be accelerated?
